description.narrative:
Goal To strengthen the institutional and technical capacity of CAFOD Zimbabwe and consortium partners to deliver high-quality, disability-inclusive programming through structured mentorship, system strengthening and targeted practical application.
Objectives 1. Embed disability inclusion across consortium systems by 30 September 2026 Lead a CBM-mentored institutionalisation process that updates policies, tools, MEAL practices (including disability-disaggregated data), safeguarding, risk analysis and referral pathways for CAFOD Zimbabwe, Caritas Masvingo, and Alfred Walter Hostel (AWH). 2. Strengthen AWH’s internal technical capacity on intellectual disability Address the absence of in-house disability technical expertise at AWH by mentoring a designated Disability Inclusion Focal Person, strengthening inclusive care and safeguarding practices, and formalising OPD linkages facilitated by CBM. 3. Demonstrate reasonable accommodation through targeted assistive support Provide and document a modest package of assistive devices and accessibility improvements at AWH and Bondolfi Primary School, generating practical learning on reasonable accommodation for wider CAFOD programming.
